tasks.label: Start NORA Music Player (Python @ :5000)
tasks.detail: Kills any process holding ports 5000/5001, then launches tools/youtube_player.py.
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Get-NetUDPEndpoint -LocalPort 5001 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; python "${workspaceFolder}\tools\youtube_player.py"

tasks.label: Clock-to-Mic Test (JLink — Flash + 20 PRE + SW Button + 10 REC)
tasks.detail: Flash firmware, 20 DAP reads pre-recording (5s), SW blue-button via EXTI_SWIER1, 10 live reads during recording. Log saved to EWARM/runs/clock_test_*.log

tasks.label: NORA Bridge (ntfy.sh relay — bypass iPhone hotspot)
tasks.detail: ONE-PRESS PC services launcher: kills any prior youtube_player.py + bridge.py, frees ports 5000/5001, installs 'requests' if missing, starts youtube_player.py in a new window (so port 5000 binds), then runs bridge.py in this panel. Required for NORA music search when on iPhone hotspot (BUG-004).
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'; try { & python -m pip show requests >$null 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host '[task] installing requests...'; & python -m pip install requests } } catch { Write-Host "[task] requests check skipped: $_" }; try { Stop-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'NORA_NtfyMusicBridge' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; Write-Host '[task] step 1: finding prior python service instances'; try { $killed = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { ($_.Name -eq 'python.exe' -or $_.Name -eq 'pythonw.exe') -and ($_.CommandLine -like '*bridge.py*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*youtube_player.py*') }); if ($killed.Count -gt 0) { Write-Host ('[task] killing ' + $killed.Count + ' prior service(s)'); $killed | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} } } else { Write-Host '[task] no prior services found' } } catch { Write-Host "[task] kill-services skipped: $_" }; Write-Host '[task] step 2: freeing port 5000 if held by non-system process'; try { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.OwningProcess -gt 4 } | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} } } catch { Write-Host "[task] port 5000 cleanup skipped: $_" }; Write-Host '[task] step 3: freeing UDP port 5001'; try { Get-NetUDPEndpoint -LocalPort 5001 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.OwningProcess -gt 4 } | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} } } catch { Write-Host "[task] port 5001 cleanup skipped: $_" }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; Write-Host '[task] step 4: starting youtube_player.py in new window'; try { Start-Process python -ArgumentList '${workspaceFolder}\tools\youtube_player.py' -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host '[task] youtube_player.py launched OK' } catch { Write-Host "[task] FAILED to launch youtube_player.py: $_" -ForegroundColor Red }; Write-Host '[task] step 5: waiting 3 sec for port 5000 to bind'; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; $listen = $null; try { $listen = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; if ($listen) { Write-Host '[task] youtube_player.py is LISTENING on port 5000 (OK)' } else { Write-Host '[task] WARNING: nothing listening on port 5000 - youtube_player.py crashed or slow to start' }; Write-Host '[task] step 6: starting bridge.py (this panel)'; & python C:\Tools\ntfy-music-bridge\bridge.py
